target: spec 013's findings_count must be the real count for a real reviewer envelope, not null
cmd: cat "$FIXTURES/findings/contract-brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/findings/or-findings-under-result.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter 2>/dev/null > env.json; printf %s "{\"hook_event_name\":\"SubagentStop\",\"agent_type\":\"loop-reviewer\",\"agent_id\":\"a\",\"session_id\":\"s\",\"last_assistant_message\":$(jq -Rs . < env.json)}" > h.json; AGENTIC_OBSERVE=1 bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" hook SubagentStop < h.json; jq -c "select(.event==\"agent_stop\") | {c: .detail.findings_count}" .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | tail -1
_note: The hook dispatches on hook_event_name INSIDE the JSON, not on the CLI argument. An input without it exits before emitting anything, so an earlier version of this case was testing nothing.
